Title: Retail solution patterns for hybrid applications

Body.Content:
Work is in progress to develop an Azure Stack solution pattern that will provide solution architects and developers with guidance and examples on how to enable scenarios that require AI inferencing on video streams at the edge. The pattern will include documentation, best practices, and a sample project with code that can be deployed to Azure Stack, making it faster and easier to develop solutions.

Read more information and check back with this blog as work progresses.

Learn more more about the Azure Stack solution patterns for hybrid applications
